            '\n'
            '  List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> _visibleApprovalDocs(\n'
            '    List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs,\n'

            '        .where((doc) => doc.data()[\'managementArchived\'] != true)\n'
            '        .toList(growable: false);\n'
            '    // HR is allowed to monitor every pending stage.  The old filter fetched\n'
            '    // pending_manager records and then silently removed them unless HR was\n'
            '    // also their assigned manager, so valid requests looked missing.\n'
            '    if (_searchQuery.isNotEmpty) {\n'
            '      filtered = filtered.where((doc) {\n'
            '        final data = doc.data();\n'
            '        return _matchesSearch([\n'
            '          data[\'employeeName\'],\n'
            '          data[\'employeeId\'],\n'
            '          data[\'department\'],\n'
            '          data[\'reason\'],\n'
            '          data[\'notes\'],\n'

            '\n'
            '  bool _canActOnApproval(Map<String, dynamic> data, UserModel reviewer) {\n'
            '    final status = \'${data[\'status\'] ?? \'\'}\';\n'
            '    final isCompanyCeo = reviewer.employeeId.trim().toUpperCase() == \'CEO-100\';\n'
            '    if (isCompanyCeo) {\n'
            '      if (status == \'pending_manager\' && data[\'managerId\'] == reviewer.uid) {\n'
            '        return true;\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      if (status == \'pending_ceo\') {\n'
            '        final ceoId = (data[\'ceoId\'] ?? \'\').toString();\n'
            '        return ceoId.isEmpty || ceoId == reviewer.uid;\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (EmployeeRole.isHr(reviewer.role)) {\n'
            '      if (status == \'pending_hr\') return true;\n'
            '      return status == \'pending_ceo\' &&\n'
            '          reviewer.employeeId.trim().toUpperCase() == \'CEO-100\';\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    return status == \'pending_manager\' && data[\'managerId\'] == reviewer.uid;\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Stream<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> _pendingStream(\n'
            '    String collection,\n'
            '    String reviewerId,\n'
            '    String role, {\n'
            '    String? employeeId,\n'
            '  }) {\n'
            '    var query = _db.collection(collection) as Query<Map<String, dynamic>>;\n'
            '    final usesManagerChain =\n'
            '        collection == \'leaves\' ||\n'
            '        collection == \'permissions\' ||\n'
            '        collection == \'advances\';\n'
            '    final reviewerIsCeo = employeeId?.trim().toUpperCase() == \'CEO-100\';\n'
            '    if (usesManagerChain && reviewerIsCeo) {\n'
            '      query = query\n'
            '          .where(\'status\', isEqualTo: \'pending_manager\')\n'
            '          .where(\'managerId\', isEqualTo: reviewerId);\n'
            '    } else if (usesManagerChain && EmployeeRole.isHr(role)) {\n'
            '      query = query.where(\n'
            '        \'status\',\n'
            '        whereIn: [\'pending\', \'pending_hr\', \'pending_manager\'],\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    } else if (usesManagerChain && EmployeeRole.canActAsApprovalManager(role)) {\n'
            '      query = query\n'
            '          .where(\'status\', isEqualTo: \'pending_manager\')\n'
            '          .where(\'managerId\', isEqualTo: reviewerId);\n'
            '    } else {\n'
            '      query = query.where(\'status\', whereIn: [\'pending\', \'pending_hr\']);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    return _cachedStream(\n'
            '      \'pending|$collection|$reviewerId|$role\',\n'
            '      query.limit(300),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'

            '          StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(\n'
            '            stream: permissionStream,\n'
            '            builder: (context, permissionSnapshot) =>\n'
            '                StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(\n'
            '                  stream: manualStream,\n'
            '                  builder: (context, manualSnapshot) {\n'

            '\n'

            '  Widget _buildSalaryDeductionsTab(\n'
            '    UserModel reviewer,\n'
            '    ThemeData theme, {\n'
            '    required bool reversalOnly,\n'
            '    bool absenceOnly = false,\n'
            '  }) {\n'
            '    if (!EmployeeRole.isHr(reviewer.role)) {\n'
            '      return _buildEmptyState(\'خصومات الراتب تراجع من HR فقط\');\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    Query<Map<String, dynamic>> deductionsQuery = _db.collection(\'attendance\');\n'
            '    if (reversalOnly) {\n'
            '      deductionsQuery = deductionsQuery.where(\n'
            '        \'salaryDeductionApprovalStatus\',\n'
            '        whereIn: const [\'approved\', \'reversed\'],\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    } else {\n'
            '      // Keep the active HR queue separate from history. Combining approved,\n'
            '      // reversed and pending records could fill the bounded page before recent\n'
            '      // pending deductions (such as Ashraf\'s) were returned.\n'
            '      deductionsQuery = deductionsQuery.where(\n'
            '        \'salaryDeductionApprovalStatus\',\n'
            '        isEqualTo: \'pending_hr\',\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(\n'
            '      stream: _cachedStream(\n'
            '        \'attendance|salary-deduction|${reviewer.uid}|reversal:$reversalOnly\',\n'
            '        deductionsQuery.limit(200),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      builder: (context, snapshot) {\n'
            '        if (snapshot.hasError) {\n'
            '          return _buildStreamError(\'تعذر تحميل خصومات الحضور\');\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        if (snapshot.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting) {\n'
            '          return _buildLoadingState(\'تحميل خصومات الحضور...\');\n'
            '        }\n'
            '\n'
            '        final loadedItems =\n'
            '            snapshot.data?.docs\n'
            '                .map((doc) => AttendanceModel.fromFirestore(doc))\n'
            '                .toList() ??\n'
            '            [];\n'
            '        final allItems = loadedItems.where((attendance) {\n'
            '          final status = attendance.salaryDeductionApprovalStatus;\n'

            '            return status == \'approved\' || status == \'reversed\';\n'
            '          }\n'
            '          final isPending = status == \'pending_hr\';\n'
            '          if (!isPending) return false;\n'
            '\n'
            '          final isAbsence =\n'
            '              attendance.salaryDeductionFraction >= 1.0 ||\n'
            '              attendance.status == \'absent\' ||\n'
            '              attendance.salaryDeductionCode == \'ABSENCE\' ||\n'
            '              attendance.salaryDeductionCode == \'full_day\';\n'
            '\n'
            '          return absenceOnly ? isAbsence : !isAbsence;\n'
            '        }).toList();\n'

            '        final items = _filterSalaryDeductions(allItems);\n'

            '                onPressed: () => _syncAbsences(reviewer),\n'

            '      stream: _cachedDerivedStream(\n'
            '        \'attendance-corrections|${reviewer.uid}\',\n'
            '        AttendanceCorrectionRequestService().pendingForHr,\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      builder: (context, snapshot) {\n'
            '        if (snapshot.hasError) {\n'
            '          return _buildStreamError(\'تعذر تحميل طلبات تصحيح الحضور\');\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        if (snapshot.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting) {\n'
            '          return _buildLoadingState(\'تحميل طلبات تصحيح الحضور...\');\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        final docs = [...?snapshot.data?.docs];\n'
            '        if (_searchQuery.isNotEmpty) {\n'
            '          docs.removeWhere((doc) {\n'
            '            final data = doc.data();\n'
            '            return !_matchesSearch([\n'
            '              data[\'employeeName\'],\n'
            '              data[\'employeeId\'],\n'
            '              data[\'department\'],\n'
            '              data[\'attendanceDate\'],\n'
            '              data[\'reason\'],\n'
            '            ]);\n'
            '          });\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        docs.sort((a, b) {\n'
            '          final left = a.data()[\'submittedAt\'] as Timestamp?;\n'
            '          final right = b.data()[\'submittedAt\'] as Timestamp?;\n'
            '          return (right?.millisecondsSinceEpoch ?? 0).compareTo(\n'
            '            left?.millisecondsSinceEpoch ?? 0,\n'
            '          );\n'
            '        });\n'
            '        if (docs.isEmpty) {\n'

            '              return AppRow(\n'
            '                id: doc.id,\n'
            '                title: data[\'employeeName\'] as String? ?? \'موظف\',\n'

            '                cells: [\n'

            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _correctArrivalTime(\n'
            '    AttendanceModel attendance,\n'
            '    UserModel reviewer,\n'
            '  ) async {\n'
            '    final parsedDay = _parseDateKey(attendance.date) ?? DateTime.now();\n'
            '    final initial = attendance.checkInTime ?? parsedDay;\n'
            '    final picked = await showTimePicker(\n'
            '      context: context,\n'
            '      initialTime: TimeOfDay.fromDateTime(initial),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    if (picked == null || !mounted) return;\n'
            '    final reasonController = TextEditingController();\n'
            '    final confirmed = await showDialog<bool>(\n'
            '      context: context,\n'
            '      builder: (dialogContext) => AlertDialog(\n'
            '        title: const Text(\'سبب تصحيح وقت الوصول\'),\n'
            '        content: TextField(\n'
            '          controller: reasonController,\n'
            '          maxLines: 2,\n'
            '          decoration: const InputDecoration(\n'
            '            hintText: \'مثال: الموظف وصل مبكراً وتعذر التسجيل\',\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        actions: [\n'
            '          TextButton(\n'
            '            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, false),\n'
            '            child: const Text(\'إلغاء\'),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          FilledButton(\n'
            '            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, true),\n'
            '            child: const Text(\'حفظ وإعادة الحساب\'),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    if (confirmed != true || !mounted) return;\n'
            '    final day = _parseDateKey(attendance.date) ?? parsedDay;\n'
            '    final correctedTime = DateTime(\n'
            '      day.year,\n'
            '      day.month,\n'
            '      day.day,\n'
            '      picked.hour,\n'
            '      picked.minute,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    // The correction feature is intentionally only for an earlier arrival\n'
            '    // (for example: the employee arrived before the phone could register).\n'
            '    // Validate it before Firestore so HR receives a useful explanation rather\n'
            '    // than a generic save/permission error.\n'
            '    if (correctedTime.isAfter(initial)) {\n'
            '      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(\n'
            '        const SnackBar(\n'
            '          content: Text(\n'
            '            \'وقت التصحيح يجب أن يكون قبل أو مساوياً لوقت الوصول المسجل.\',\n'

            '        attendanceId: attendance.attendanceId,\n'
            '        reviewerId: reviewer.uid,\n'
            '        correctedTime: correctedTime,\n'
            '        reason: reasonController.text,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      if (mounted) {\n'
            '        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(\n'
            '          const SnackBar(content: Text(\'تم تصحيح الوقت وإعادة حساب الخصم.\')),\n'
            '        );\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    } catch (error) {\n'
            '      if (mounted) {\n'
            '        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(\n'
            '          SnackBar(\n'
            '            content: Text(\'تعذر تعديل الوقت: ${userFacingError(error)}\'),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        );\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    } finally {\n'
            '      reasonController.dispose();\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'

            '\n'
            '  Widget _buildSecurityReviewsTab(UserModel reviewer, ThemeData theme) {\n'

            '      return _buildEmptyState(\'مراجعة أمان الحضور من HR فقط\');\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(\n'
            '      stream: _cachedStream(\n'
            '        \'attendance|checkin-security|${reviewer.uid}\',\n'
            '        _db\n'
            '            .collection(\'attendance\')\n'
            '            .where(\'securityReviewStatus\', isEqualTo: \'pending_hr\'),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      builder: (context, checkInSnapshot) {\n'
            '        return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(\n'
            '          stream: _cachedStream(\n'
            '            \'attendance|checkout-security|${reviewer.uid}\',\n'
            '            _db\n'
            '                .collection(\'attendance\')\n'
            '                .where(\'checkoutSecurityReviewStatus\', isEqualTo: \'pending_hr\'),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          builder: (context, checkoutSnapshot) {\n'
            '            if (checkInSnapshot.hasError || checkoutSnapshot.hasError) {\n'
            '              return _buildStreamError(\'تعذر تحميل مراجعات أمان الحضور\');\n'
            '            }\n'
            '            final waiting =\n'
            '                checkInSnapshot.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting ||\n'
            '                checkoutSnapshot.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting;\n'
            '            if (waiting) {\n'
            '              return _buildLoadingState(\'تحميل مراجعات أمان الحضور...\');\n'
            '            }\n'
            '\n'
            '            final items = <_SecurityReviewItem>[\n'
            '              ...((checkInSnapshot.data?.docs ?? []).map(\n'
            '                (doc) => _SecurityReviewItem(\n'
            '                  attendance: AttendanceModel.fromFirestore(doc),\n'
            '                  checkout: false,\n'
            '                  docId: doc.id,\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              )),\n'
            '              ...((checkoutSnapshot.data?.docs ?? []).map(\n'
            '                (doc) => _SecurityReviewItem(\n'
            '                  attendance: AttendanceModel.fromFirestore(doc),\n'
            '                  checkout: true,\n'
            '                  docId: doc.id,\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              )),\n'
            '            ];\n'
            '\n'
            '            items.sort((a, b) {\n'
            '              final aTime =\n'
            '                  (a.checkout\n'
            '                      ? a.attendance.checkOutTime\n'
            '                      : a.attendance.checkInTime) ??\n'

            '                  DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(0);\n'

            '                      ? b.attendance.checkOutTime\n'
            '                      : b.attendance.checkInTime) ??\n'
            '                  _parseDateKey(b.attendance.date) ??\n'
            '                  DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(0);\n'
            '              return bTime.compareTo(aTime);\n'
            '            });\n'
            '\n'
            '            if (_searchQuery.isNotEmpty) {\n'
            '              items.removeWhere(\n'
            '                (item) => !_matchesSearch([\n'
            '                  item.attendance.employeeName,\n'
            '                  item.attendance.employeeId,\n'
            '                  item.attendance.locationName,\n'
            '                  item.attendance.date,\n'
            '                  item.attendance.locationRiskMessage,\n'
            '                  item.attendance.checkoutLocationRiskMessage,\n'
            '                ]),\n'
            '              );\n'
            '            }\n'
            '\n'
            '            if (items.isEmpty) {\n'
            '              return _buildEmptyState(\'لا توجد مراجعات أمنية معلقة\');\n'
            '            }\n'
            '\n'
            '            final reviewById = {for (final item in items) item.docId: item};\n'
            '            final rows = <AppRow>[\n'
            '              for (final item in items)\n'
            '                AppRow(\n'
            '                  id: item.docId,\n'
            '                  title: item.attendance.employeeName,\n'
            '                  leading: Icons.security,\n'
            '                  accentColor: ZaWolfColors.warning,\n'
            '                  cells: [\n'
            '                    item.checkout ? \'مراجعة انصراف\' : \'مراجعة حضور\',\n'
            '                    item.attendance.date,\n'
            '                    item.attendance.locationName,\n'
            '                  ],\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '            ];\n'
            '\n'
            '            return LayoutBuilder(\n'
            '              builder: (context, constraints) {\n'
            '                if (!_requestMasterDetailEnabled ||\n'
            '                    constraints.maxWidth < 980) {\n'

            '                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),\n'
            '                    itemCount: items.length,\n'
            '                    itemBuilder: (context, index) => _buildSecurityReviewCard(\n'
            '                      item: items[index],\n'
            '                      reviewer: reviewer,\n'
            '                      theme: theme,\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  );\n'
            '                }\n'
            '                return DsMasterDetailView(\n'
            '                  columns: const [\n'
            '                    AppColumn(\'الموظف\'),\n'
            '                    AppColumn(\'النوع\', width: 140),\n'
            '                    AppColumn(\'التاريخ\', width: 130),\n'
            '                    AppColumn(\'الفرع\'),\n'
            '                  ],\n'

            '      },\n'

            '                  const TextStyle(\n'
            '                    color: Colors.white,\n'
            '                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,\n'

            '              _buildInfoLine(\n'
            '                \'دقة الموقع\',\n'
            '                \'${accuracy.toStringAsFixed(0)} متر\',\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            if (distance != null && radius != null)\n'
            '              _buildInfoLine(\n'
            '                \'المسافة من الفرع\',\n'
            '                \'${distance.toStringAsFixed(0)} متر من نطاق ${radius.toStringAsFixed(0)} متر\',\n'

            '            if (reasons.isNotEmpty)\n'

            '                  spacing: 8,\n'
            '                  runSpacing: 8,\n'
            '                  children: reasons\n'
            '                      .map(\n'
            '                        (reason) => Chip(\n'
            '                          label: Text(_riskReasonLabel(reason)),\n'

            '                          labelStyle: const TextStyle(\n'
            '                            color: ZaWolfColors.textSecondary,\n'
